title: Use one shared money formatter and one shared date formatter instead of about a dozen and nineteen private copies

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: function money() in app/(public)/housing/[id]/page.tsx:73, components/marketplace/order-share-note.tsx:11, order-transfer-ledger.tsx:13, lib/sites/house-theme.ts:244, lib/spaces/profile-data.ts:347, lib/studio/entities/event.ts:117, product.ts:74, service.ts:93; formatPrice in components/spaces/membership-join-card.tsx:47 and lib/spaces/benefits-form.ts:222; formatMoney lib/crm/pipeline-core.ts:95; formatCents lib/pricing/display.ts:58. Also 30 `new Intl.NumberFormat(` and 36 `style: 'currency'` sites. || git grep 'function formatDate|fmtDate|formatTime' hits app/(main)/admin/events/events-admin-list.tsx (2), components/messages/thread.tsx, components/rooms/room-thread.tsx, components/events/upcoming-event-rows.tsx, app/(main)/events/[slug]/event-member-page.tsx and 13 more. lib/utils.ts:84 documents `timeZone: 'UTC'` as load-bearing for the shared event formatters; local ones do not necessarily follow it.

WHY IT MATTERS: Currency rounding, zero-decimal currencies and 'Free' wording can drift between checkout, receipts and listings. Money display bugs cost trust at launch. Timezone off-by-one on event dates is a known class in this repo (the shared helper's own comment); each private copy is a place it can recur.

FIX DIRECTION: Pick lib/pricing/display.ts as the single formatter (currency-aware), migrate the copies, and ratchet new local `function money(` via check-adoption. Route through the lib/utils event-date helpers; ratchet raw toLocale*String in app/components.

PARTIAL-TO-PROBE 2026-11-16: the probe's two counts now pass (hand-rolled money functions 11 -> 1; toLocale date and time calls in app and components 140 -> 81). Money: lib/commerce/types.ts is the one home (formatPriceCents plus new formatPriceAmount, formatCentsFixed, formatPriceCentsOrBlank, formatCentsWithCode); the Studio, profile-data, house-theme, marketplace transfer notes, housing, benefits-form and join-card copies now delegate (payout transfer amounts keep two decimals). Dates: lib/format-date.ts holds formatDateMedium, formatDateShort, formatDateWeekday and formatTimeShort, each the exact option bag it replaced, so output is unchanged. REMAINING: formatMoney in lib/crm/pipeline-core.ts (takes dollars, client-safe module, deliberately separate), about 80 toLocale calls with other option bags, undefined locale or non-literal options, and the lib/utils.ts event formatters; folding those needs a decision on locale handling, so they were left. benefits-form.test.ts imports formatPriceCents under its old name.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
